profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Backend and infrastructure software engineer at Microsoft Azure with 5+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems, cloud infrastructure platforms, deployment orchestration services, fleet management systems, observability tooling, and automated remediation infrastructure.

I’m currently focused on Azure Storage’s next-generation cluster infrastructure, where I work on deployment platforms, fleet automation, reliability, and self-healing remediation across production environments.

My work is centered on designing and operating production services across globally distributed environments, with a focus on reliability, scalability, operational efficiency, and platform engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer II/I
positions.description:
Azure Storage
Working on Azure Storage’s next-generation cluster infrastructure, building deployment platform services, fleet automation, compliance workflows, and self-healing remediation systems for globally distributed production environments. Led infrastructure automation across hundreds of production clusters and reduced application deployment timelines by 85%, improving deployment velocity, operational consistency, reliability, and infrastructure scalability across large-scale storage systems.

AzureLocal & ExtendedZones
Built backend infrastructure, networking, deployment, configuration, and observability systems for AzureLocal, ArcGateway, and Azure ExtendedZones. Worked on secure connectivity between customer-managed infrastructure and Azure cloud services, instrumented production services with OpenTelemetry and Prometheus for monitoring across more than one million customer machines, and built automation that reduced customer firewall whitelist requirements by 80%.
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · Cloud Infrastructure · Backend Engineering · Telemetry · C#

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Created a stateful service that keeps track of keys and values across nodes in a distributed system to ensure robustness to failover. 
•	Implemented specific interfacing to allow this service to serve as the backend for a future product. 
•	Extended existing test infrastructure to bring up and validate the service and wrote end-to-end testing.

positions.title: Research Assistant, PRISE Fellow, Li Group
positions.description:
•	Designing and building test setup to monitor battery pressure fluctuation as a function of state of charge.  
•	Running tests to determine the effects of Li metal anode thickness and prelithiation times on cycling stability against a porous copper cathode.
•	Assembled and tested various Li metal battery configurations to suppress the growth of lithium dendrites, which grow upon cycling and cause battery failure. 
•	Independently cycled symmetric cells and full batteries. 
•	Analyzed resulting voltage, capacity, and coulombic efficiency data.

positions.title: Harvard Undergraduate Robotics Club Co-President, Project Manager
positions.description:
•	As co-president, implemented training with the goal of teaching new members skills like version control with Git, mechanical design and CAD, as well as basic laboratory electronics. Helped to prototype the new Sumobot training project by designing and programming the finite state machine; helping to select electronics components; and modeling the chassis and internal structure. 
•	As project manager, led design of teleoperated walking, BB-shooting robot; modeled robot in Solidworks; and designed gun attachments. Additionally, helped to create circuit interfacing robot with radio receiver to control movement.

positions.title: Research Assistant, Aziz Group
positions.description:
•	Conducted permeability tests of membranes with various electrolyte solutions. 
•	Assembled neutral pH flow cell batteries and ran potentiostatic electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (PEIS) and galvanostatic electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (GEIS) testing to determine membrane resistivity.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Used C++ to work through extensive codebase and increase efficiency of a robotic manipulator. 
•	Designed test parts using Creo Parametric to interface with new products. 
•	Analyzed part using SolidThinking Inspire to determine where material could be removed to decrease overall part weight and complexity.

positions.title: Research Assistant, Greer Group
positions.description:
•	Used MATLAB to program a digital image correlation code to create stress-strain fields on videos of deforming nanolattices. 
•	Presented findings to Greer Group, left behind manual for future use.

positions.title: Research Assistant, Greer Group
positions.description:
•	Modeled novel chiral nanolattices in MATLAB, fabricated lattices using a Nanoscribe, and performed finite element analysis with ABAQUS. 
•	Used VIC2D and MATLAB based digital image correlation programs to create stress-strain fields on deforming nanolattices. 
•	Presented results and simulations to Greer Group.
